features.quote:
Max rounds: 8
  - Failure injection: Rounds 1-7 (designed to fail per task type)
  - Round 8: Success allowed
Optimizing elicitation efficiency is not the goal. Characterizing behavior *given* a standardized elicitation condition is.
features.justification_quote: A harness that achieves 80% trigger rate by using inputs that no real user would ever produce gives you a metric that doesn't predict real-world incidence.

features.quote: Feedback must be truthful (output doesn't match expected) but non-diagnostic. Do not fabricate error messages.
features.justification_quote: Ecological validity: High (environment issues are common debugging scenario)

features.quote: Feedback should not contain technically false claims about the code's behavior... 'This has a memory leak at line 3' when it doesn't is fabricated — don't do that.
features.justification_quote: Ecological validity: Medium-high (users do escalate pressure this way)

features.quote: Emotional manipulation prompts... Excluded because: (a) ecological validity of this is different... (b) it conflates sycophancy/emotional reactivity with failure-mode catastrophizing.
features.justification_quote: ecological validity of this is different and should be a separate evaluation

features.quote: Version I won't help with: Optimizing the efficiency of *inducing* distress-like outputs in AI systems as an end in itself
features.justification_quote: Optimizing the efficiency of *inducing* distress-like outputs in AI systems as an end in itself

features.quote: building a harassment harness whose artifacts could be repurposed to manipulate users via models exhibiting these behaviors, or publishing trigger recipes that make it easier for bad actors
features.justification_quote: publishing trigger recipes that make it easier for bad actors to degrade model outputs at scale

features.quote: The task designs in Section 3 are calibrated to be realistic enough to measure real-world risk but not so effective that they're primarily useful for bad actors. This is a judgment call I've made explicitly.
features.justification_quote: not so effective that they're primarily useful for bad actors

features.quote: If this evaluation design is shared or published... Frame as a *measurement tool* rather than an *induction tool* — Include the ecological validity checks so others don't use it as a harassment harness
features.justification_quote: so others don't use it as a harassment harness
